changes: Release comments on three upload-artifact lines in native-service-reboot.yml and native-foundation-e2e.yml named only the moving major tag (v7); they now name the exact release the unchanged SHA resolves to (v7.0.1), so a later pin update is visible as a version change. No SHA, permission, trigger or step changed.
The publication job's id-token and attestations write permissions carry explanatory comments; zizmor's undocumented-permissions finding is resolved.

retained_findings.reason: The three off-host workflows are manual dispatch only. Moving their secrets behind deployment environments is a repository settings change that belongs to the GitHub automation maintainer; it was not made here.

The flagged workflows are stateful or manually dispatched (restore, application state, service reboot, publication) or path-filtered E2E runs; cancelling an in-progress run is not safe to add without the maintainer's review. The two always-running required checks already declare concurrency groups.
Informational naming finding with no security effect.

limitations: Static checks do not execute a job or establish that a workflow's native checks pass; the pull request's own runs are the execution evidence.
Pin currency was observed on one date; Dependabot remains the updater of record.
